lessons.title: Jyutping: initials and finals
The six tones, numbered 1 to 6
Hello, thanks and sorry: 唔該 and 多謝
First characters: strokes and radicals
係 (to be) and the pronouns 我, 你, 佢
Introducing yourself: 我叫…, 我係美國人
唔 (not) and yes/no questions: 係唔係, 好唔好
Question words: 咩, 邊個, 邊度, 幾時, 點解
Numbers: 一 to 十, 百, 千, 萬
Classifiers: 個, 本, 杯, 張, and 'my' with 我本書
嘅: my, your, his (我嘅, 佢嘅)
Family and age
喺 (at, in), not 係: 我喺香港
有 and 冇: have, and there is (never 唔有)
Sentence-final particles: 呀, 啦, 吖, 呢
Money and prices: 幾多錢？, 蚊, 平啲
Ordering food and drink: 唔該, 要, 埋單
Clock time and dates: 幾點？, 三點半, 星期一
My day: time and place before the verb
Want, can, like: 想, 可以, 識, 會, 鍾意, 要
Choices and 'also': A 定 B？ and 都
Describing and comparing: 好, 太, 幾, 過 (no 係)
咗: done; 冇 (didn't) and 未 (not yet)
緊 and 過: doing it now, and ever done it
去 and 嚟: going and coming; 搭車, 坐地鐵
Directions: 左邊, 右邊, 直行, 對面
Suggestions and invitations: 不如…？, 一齊…吖

decks.name: Jyutping sounds
decks.desc: One character per sound point: the Jyutping letters English readers misread (j, z, c, ng-, gw, aa / a, eo, oe, yu, final -p -t -k, syllabic m and ng)

decks.name: Tone twins
decks.desc: Same letters, different tone, different word: 詩 史 試 時 市 事, 買 / 賣, 四 / 死, 係 / 喺

decks.name: First characters
decks.desc: Pictures and compounds to recognise: 人 口 日 月 山 水 木 林 明 好 休, and the 口 that marks spoken-Cantonese characters

decks.name: Greetings and courtesy
decks.desc: Hello, the two thank-yous 唔該 and 多謝, sorry, goodbye and good night

decks.name: People and family
decks.desc: Pronouns with 哋, family members on both sides, and friends

decks.name: About me
decks.desc: Name, nationality, where you live, languages, and small talk about yourself

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Numbers to ten thousand and beyond, 兩 and 二, and prices in 蚊

decks.name: Classifiers
decks.desc: Number, this / that or owner + classifier + noun: 個, 本, 杯, 張, 隻, 部, 架

decks.name: Food and drink
decks.desc: Dim sum, the cha chaan teng (Hong Kong café), drinks, and ordering and paying

decks.name: Shopping
decks.desc: Prices, sizes, a little bargaining, and paying by Octopus card

decks.name: Time, days and dates
decks.desc: Clock time, days of the week, dates, today and tomorrow, and parts of the day

decks.name: Around town and directions
decks.desc: Where things are, left and right, across and next to, and asking the way

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: The MTR, buses and minibuses, taxis, ferries, the Octopus card and tickets

decks.name: Work and study
decks.desc: Jobs, school, learning Cantonese, and what you can and know how to do

decks.name: Health and help
decks.desc: Feeling sick, the pharmacy, the doctor, and asking for help

decks.name: Describing things
decks.desc: Adjectives for people, food, weather and prices, with 好, 太, 幾 and comparisons with 過

decks.name: Questions and particles
decks.desc: Question words, A-not-A questions, and the sentence-final particles 呀, 啦, 吖, 呢, 㗎

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: False friends and calques: 係 with adjectives, 唔有, 二個, 咗 and 過, 唔該 or 多謝, and greetings that are not what they seem

decks.name: Top nouns
decks.desc: The most-used everyday nouns, with the measure word they take: 時間, 錢, 屋企, 地方, 電話

decks.name: Top verbs
decks.desc: The most-used verbs: 講, 話, 做, 食, 睇, 知, 想, 要, 嚟, 識

decks.name: Top adjectives
decks.desc: Describing words, which work like verbs and take no 係: 靚, 多, 新, 高, 快, 攰, 開心

decks.name: Top adverbs
decks.desc: Before the verb: 都, 就, 仲, 先, 再, 太, 最, 已經, 成日, 而家

decks.name: Top pronouns
decks.desc: 你, 佢, 自己, 大家, mine and yours with 嘅, this and that, who, what and where

decks.name: Top coverbs and place words
decks.desc: What Cantonese uses instead of prepositions: 同, 畀, 幫, 用, 對, and place words like 入面, 隔籬, 對面

decks.name: Top conjunctions
decks.desc: 同埋, 但係, 不過, 因為, 所以, 如果, 或者, 定係, 然後

decks.name: Top interjections
decks.desc: What people really exclaim: 好嘢！ 死喇！ 係咩？ 唔係嘛！ 加油！

decks.name: Top words
decks.desc: Numbers to twenty, question words, yes and no, this year, today and the days of the week

decks.name: Top measure words
decks.desc: The measure words not yet taught on their own: 個, 隻, 本, 張, 條, 件, 位, 間, 碗, 次, 啲

decks.name: Top particles
decks.desc: Sentence-final 呀, 啦, 喎, 囉, 咩, 㗎, 呢 and the aspect markers 緊, 過, 住

decks.name: Flirting
decks.desc: Words people flirt with, the phrases built from them, asking someone out, and kind ways to say yes or no

decks.name: Compliments
decks.desc: Praising food, work, homes and kids, and the modest ways Hong Kong people answer praise
